sources.title: Mitutoyo — Caliper scale reading and measurement applications

translations.同一刻度的放大图: Magnified view of the same scales
translations.主尺与游标刻度，第几条对齐决定小数读数: Main and vernier scales; the aligned line determines the fractional reading
translations.内测量爪撑住槽的内壁: Internal jaws contact the walls of a slot
translations.外测量爪与小球两侧接触: External jaws contact opposite sides of a sphere
translations.测量面已经贴合，再读取刻度: Measuring faces are in contact; now read the scales
translations.测量面尚未贴合，先调整位置: The faces are not in contact; adjust position first
translations.测微螺杆由同一螺纹运动，测砧与螺杆夹住被测物: The micrometer spindle follows its screw; anvil and spindle contact the specimen
translations.放大的测量面与薄样品: Magnified measuring faces and thin specimen
translations.已接触：继续转动微调钮不会压入样品: In contact: further fine-control rotation does not penetrate the specimen
translations.螺杆尚未接触样品: The spindle has not contacted the specimen
translations.固定半毫米刻度加上微分筒读数，并保留估读位: Add sleeve half-millimetres and the thimble reading, retaining an estimated digit
translations.铜丝密绕木棒，测量多个直径的总长后除以圈数: Wire wound tightly around a rod; divide the measured span by turn count
translations.若总长读数误差为 ±0.1 mm: If the total-length reading error is ±0.1 mm
translations.圈间留缝，会把直径估得偏大。: Gaps between turns overestimate the diameter.
translations.先让测量面贴合，再找刻度的对齐: Establish contact, then find scale alignment
translations.同一螺纹，把旋转变成细小的直线位移: One screw converts rotation into small translations
translations.把一次难读的小长度，累积成清楚的总长度: Accumulate a small hard-to-read length into a clearer total
translations.圈数增加能减小读数影响；不保证消除系统误差。: More turns reduce reading effects, but do not guarantee removal of systematic error.
translations.模型保留刻度几何；真实测量还需对正、控力与重复读数。: The model preserves scale geometry; real measurements also need alignment, force control and repetition.
translations.游标几何由主尺 1 mm 与游标小分度的差值得出。测微器每转前进 0.5 mm，: Vernier geometry comes from the difference between 1 mm main-scale divisions and smaller vernier divisions. A micrometer advances 0.5 mm per turn; 50 divisions give 0.01 mm with one further estimated digit. Contact prevents specimen penetration. Accumulation approximates tightly packed circular cross-sections and omits helix angle and deformation. The ±0.1 mm total-length reading bound is an explicit assumption; gap, zero and deformation errors do not vanish merely by adding turns.
translations.怎样把看不清的小长度，变成可靠的读数？: How can a small hard-to-see length become a reliable reading?
translations.用真实刻度差、螺纹位移与密绕累积，练习卡尺、测微器和铜丝直径测量。: Use vernier pitch differences, screw translation and tightly wound accumulation to measure with calipers, micrometers and a ruler.

cues.title: 先选择正确的测量面
cues.caption: 外测量爪贴住小球两侧，才能读取外径。
cues.captionEn: External jaws must contact both sides before reading the diameter.
cues.zh: 先看卡尺的两片外测量爪。小球放在它们之间，缓慢移动游标，让两侧测量面刚好贴住小球。没有贴合时，刻度表示的只是量爪间距，不是小球直径。位置对正以后，再把目光移到主尺和游标。
cues.en: Watch the external caliper jaws. Place the sphere between them and move the slider until both faces just touch it. Before contact, the scale shows only jaw separation, not the sphere diameter. Once aligned and touching, look at the main and vernier scales.

cues.title: 找第几条刻度对齐
cues.caption: 主尺 23 mm，加上第七条对应的 0.7 mm。
cues.captionEn: Add 23 mm on the main scale to 0.7 mm from the seventh aligned line.
cues.zh: 放大同一组刻度。游标零线已经越过主尺的二十三毫米，但还不到二十四毫米。再看游标，第七条线与主尺对齐。十格游标的每一格比主尺少零点一毫米，所以小数部分是零点七毫米，总读数为二十三点七毫米。
cues.en: Magnify the same scales. The vernier zero has passed twenty-three millimetres but has not reached twenty-four. The seventh vernier line aligns with a main-scale line. Each of ten vernier divisions is one tenth of a millimetre shorter, giving a fractional reading of point seven and a total of twenty-three point seven millimetres.

cues.title: 换成内测量爪
cues.caption: 量槽宽时，让内测量爪向两侧撑开。
cues.captionEn: To measure a slot, expand the internal jaws against both walls.
cues.zh: 要测槽的宽度，就换用上方的内测量爪。把两片爪放进槽内，缓慢撑开，使外侧测量面贴住两边内壁。读数原理仍是主尺加游标，但接触的是另一组测量面。量爪不能歪斜，也不需要用力挤压。
cues.en: For a slot width, use the upper internal jaws. Place them inside the slot and expand them gently until their outer measuring faces contact both walls. The reading still combines main and vernier scales, but the contact faces are different. Keep the tool aligned and avoid squeezing.

cues.title: 一圈只前进半毫米
cues.titleEn: One turn advances half a millimetre
cues.caption: 螺杆平移与微分筒旋转来自同一螺距。
cues.captionEn: Spindle translation and thimble rotation share one screw pitch.
cues.zh: 现在看螺旋测微器。旋转微分筒，测微螺杆沿轴线移动。这里转过一整圈，开口只改变零点五毫米。圆周再分成五十格，每格对应零点零一毫米。细小的直线位移被转成较容易观察的转动，而不是凭空增加数字。
cues.en: Now watch the micrometer. Turning the thimble moves the spindle along its axis. One complete turn changes the opening by only half a millimetre. Fifty divisions around the circumference therefore represent one hundredth of a millimetre each. Tiny translation becomes a more observable rotation.

cues.title: 半毫米线有没有露出？
cues.caption: 固定刻度与微分筒相加，并保留一位估读。
cues.captionEn: Add sleeve and thimble readings, retaining one estimated digit.
cues.zh: 轻轻接触样品后读数。先看固定刻度，六点五毫米的半毫米线已经露出。再看参考线对应的微分筒位置，在二十二与二十三格之间，大约是二十二点五格。两部分相加，得到六点七二五毫米。最后一位是估读，不代表仪器绝对准确。
cues.en: Read after gently contacting the specimen. The sleeve exposes the six point five millimetre half-mark. The reference line meets the thimble about halfway between divisions twenty-two and twenty-three, or twenty-two point five divisions. Adding both parts gives six point seven two five millimetres. The last digit is estimated, not a guarantee of absolute accuracy.

cues.title: 先检查零点，再量薄样品
cues.titleEn: Check zero before a thin specimen
cues.caption: 示数减去零点读数，才得到修正后的厚度。
cues.captionEn: Subtract the zero reading to obtain corrected thickness.
cues.zh: 先让两个测量面闭合，发现示数是零点零三毫米，这就是本次的零点读数。再放入薄纸，靠近时改用微调机构，避免继续挤压。接触处已经另外放大。最后把纸张的示数减去零点零三毫米，得到修正后的厚度；头发也可以用同样的步骤测量。
cues.en: Close the measuring faces first. The instrument indicates point zero three millimetres, its zero reading in this example. Insert thin paper and use the fine mechanism near contact to avoid further squeezing. The contact is separately magnified. Subtract point zero three millimetres from the indicated thickness; hair can be measured with the same procedure.

cues.title: 把十圈看成一个总长度
cues.titleEn: Measure ten turns as one span
cues.caption: 密绕后测总长，再除以圈数；间隙会带来偏大。
cues.captionEn: Measure the tightly wound span and divide by turns; gaps cause overestimation.
cues.zh: 如果只有普通刻度尺，可以把铜丝密密绕在木棒上。先看一圈，再逐渐增加到十圈。用同一把尺测量总长度，然后除以圈数。假设总长读数的误差仍是零点一毫米，分到每圈就只剩零点零一毫米。但必须密绕；圈间的缝隙也会被量进去，不能靠增加圈数自动消除。
cues.en: With only an ordinary ruler, wind the wire tightly around a rod. Start with one turn and increase to ten. Measure the total span with the same ruler, then divide by turn count. If the total-length reading error remains one tenth of a millimetre, its per-turn contribution becomes one hundredth. Winding must be tight: gaps add to the measured span and do not automatically disappear with more turns.
